messages:
Elaine H: Hey team — quick idea: run a 30-day conversion rebate for SI-led pilots that originate from marketplace trials. target: nudge pilot customers to convert to 1yr reserved commits. thinking ~15% rebate applied to first 3 months of committed spend if they convert within 30 days after pilot ends.
Diego M: Love the nudge. curious about mechanics — is rebate a marketplace private-offer credit or a direct co-sell credit?
Elaine H: Prefer marketplace private-offer credit so it's visible in their billing. keeps accounting simpler for the SI.
Samir: Marketplace rules vary by cloud. need to confirm private-offer crediting timelines and whether we can auto-apply for conversions. I can check AWS/GCP docs tomorrow.
Nina (SI Lead): From SI POV, shorter window is better — 30 days keeps momentum. also ask: can we tier the rebate for different pilot sizes? e.g., 15% for >$50k ARR, 10% for $10-50k, 5% under that.
Carlos (Finance): Tiering OK but we need clear revenue recognition plan. credits applied in quarter of conversion will reduce recognized revenue — fine if forecasted. require a cap per customer. suggest cap = $150k rebate.
Lena (Legal): Need simple T&Cs for private offers and partner eligibility. no open guarantees on SLA. also want a clause preventing double-dipping with other promotional credits. I can draft language.
Marketplace Bot: Draft private-offer created: https://mp.example.com/private-offers/draft-4832 — requires partnerID and offer SKU mapping.
Diego M: Thanks bot. ops question: do we require SI to register leads in partner portal to qualify? that helps attribution and co-marketing.
Nina (SI Lead): Yes please. we'll require SI to register pilot in portal before pilot launch. otherwise we can't backfill attribution.
Samir: Implementation notes for eng/ops: need a private-offer SKU that maps to a rebate schedule. example config: 
```
rebate_window_days: 30
tiers: [{min_usd:50000, pct:15},{min_usd:10000, pct:10},{min_usd:0, pct:5}]
cap_usd:150000
apply_to_months:3
```
Keep it lean.
Carlos (Finance): Also track "converted ARR" metric and coupon redemption rate. we'll use that to compute program ROI — target >25% conversion to commits.
Elaine H: Great. next steps: Samir check marketplace constraints by EOD tomorrow; Lena draft T&Cs by Wed; Carlos propose cap/ROI model; Nina confirm partner registration flow. I'll put a short launch plan in Notion and loop in growth for comms. :thumbsup:
